title: Official blog knowledge stage 3
summary: This iteration adds a generated official blog excerpt page for curated OpenAI and Anthropic knowledge records. The page links from the homepage, renders summaries, key ideas, practice checklists, related blog anchors, and stable related-report containers, and stays backed by the minimized public knowledge projection.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "official blog excerpt page|official blog knowledge generated file|daily dry-run requires an explicit report date" tests/unit.test.js tests/e2e/site.e2e.js tests/publish.test.js
Playwright desktop/mobile screenshot inspection for docs/index.html and docs/official-blogs/index.html

lessons.lesson: The official blog graph needs a stable reader-facing page, not only a homepage module and JSON file.
lessons.evidence: Stage 3 generates `official-blogs/index.html`, links it from `#official-blog-knowledge`, includes it in generated-file planning, and keeps daily dry-run staging date-scoped while preserving the page.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future official blog graph expansion centered on this page unless a separate per-record detail route becomes necessary.

lessons.lesson: Related daily report links should have a deterministic container before all historical dates are curated.
lessons.evidence: Each excerpt card renders `data-related-report-links`, so adding `related_report_dates` to knowledge records later automatically turns the container into report links.
lessons.recommended_action: In the next stage, populate selected `related_report_dates` from daily report items and add reverse links from daily pages.

lessons.lesson: The public excerpt page must stay on the minimized projection.
lessons.evidence: Unit and E2E checks assert the excerpt page and public JSON omit admission policy, rationale, source audit, self-check, and candidate/debug fields.
lessons.recommended_action: Do not render authoring or admission metadata on public knowledge surfaces.

suggestions.issue: The Stage 2 homepage module did not provide a dedicated blog excerpt surface for future daily-report back-links or trend tracking.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 3 adds `renderOfficialBlogsHtml`, `docs/official-blogs/index.html`, homepage linkage, generated-file planning, daily dry-run staging, unit tests, E2E checks, and page-check coverage for the new homepage entrypoint.
suggestions.suggestion: Use a generated official blog excerpt page as the first knowledge-graph surface.
suggestions.expected_benefit: New OpenAI/Anthropic product, model, and engineering-practice posts can be summarized once and linked from daily reports, later reports, and trend tracking without exposing internal triage metadata.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through renderer, site build, publish plan, checklist, unit tests, e2e browser checks, and validation.
validation_evidence: official blog excerpt page renders reader safe graph links
official blog knowledge generated file public projection is generated and planned
daily dry-run requires an explicit report date and stays date-scoped

followups.action: Populate `related_report_dates` from daily report items and render reverse links from daily reports to official blog records.
Consider per-record routes only after the single excerpt page becomes too dense for reader scanning.
